_comment: SYNTHETIC drug-interaction reference backing the MCP medication_interaction_check tool. Generated for this capstone. Simplified for demonstration and NOT a clinical reference. Pair keys are lowercase, alphabetically ordered, joined by '|'.

fluconazole|warfarin.description: Fluconazole strongly inhibits CYP2C9, the main enzyme clearing S-warfarin. INR can rise sharply within 2-3 days, with a substantial bleeding risk.
fluconazole|warfarin.recommendation: Avoid the combination where an alternative antifungal exists. If unavoidable, reduce the warfarin dose and recheck INR within 3 days with anticoagulation clinic oversight.

amiodarone|warfarin.description: Amiodarone inhibits warfarin metabolism and its long half-life means the effect accumulates over weeks. INR typically rises with a delayed onset.
amiodarone|warfarin.recommendation: Anticipate a warfarin dose reduction of roughly one third. Recheck INR within 3-5 days and monitor weekly for the first month.

furosemide|ibuprofen.description: NSAIDs blunt the diuretic and natriuretic effect of loop diuretics and reduce renal perfusion, precipitating heart-failure decompensation and acute kidney injury.
furosemide|ibuprofen.recommendation: Stop the NSAID. Use acetaminophen for analgesia in heart failure and chronic kidney disease.

ibuprofen|sacubitril-valsartan.description: The combination of an NSAID with renin-angiotensin system blockade and a diuretic ('triple whammy') markedly raises the risk of acute kidney injury.

apixaban|ibuprofen.description: Additive bleeding risk: NSAIDs impair platelet function and cause gastric mucosal injury alongside direct oral anticoagulation.
apixaban|ibuprofen.recommendation: Avoid. If an NSAID is unavoidable, add gastroprotection and counsel on bleeding signs.

metformin|sacubitril-valsartan.description: Renin-angiotensin system blockade can reduce renal function, raising metformin accumulation and lactic-acidosis risk in chronic kidney disease.
metformin|sacubitril-valsartan.recommendation: Monitor renal function; reduce the metformin dose if eGFR falls below 45.

furosemide|metformin.description: Loop diuretics can reduce renal clearance of metformin and raise its plasma concentration.
furosemide|metformin.recommendation: Check renal function after any diuretic dose increase.

metoprolol succinate|sacubitril-valsarta.description: Additive hypotension, particularly during uptitration of either agent.
metoprolol succinate|sacubitril-valsarta.recommendation: Uptitrate one agent at a time and monitor blood pressure and symptoms.

amiodarone|atorvastatin.description: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4, raising atorvastatin exposure and the risk of myopathy.
amiodarone|atorvastatin.recommendation: Limit atorvastatin to 20 mg daily with amiodarone; counsel on muscle pain.

omeprazole|warfarin.description: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19 and can modestly potentiate warfarin.
omeprazole|warfarin.recommendation: Monitor INR when starting or stopping the proton-pump inhibitor.

amoxicillin-clavulanate|warfarin.description: Broad-spectrum antibiotics reduce gut flora vitamin K synthesis, potentiating warfarin.
amoxicillin-clavulanate|warfarin.recommendation: Check INR mid-course and at completion.

apixaban|fluconazole.description: Fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, raising apixaban exposure and bleeding risk.
apixaban|fluconazole.recommendation: Consider an alternative antifungal or a dose adjustment; counsel on bleeding signs.

lisinopril|spironolactone.description: Additive hyperkalaemia risk from combined renin-angiotensin blockade and potassium-sparing diuresis.
lisinopril|spironolactone.recommendation: Check potassium and creatinine within 5-7 days of initiation.

sacubitril-valsartan|spironolactone.description: Additive hyperkalaemia risk, amplified in chronic kidney disease.
sacubitril-valsartan|spironolactone.recommendation: Check potassium and creatinine within 5-7 days and again at 4 weeks.

lisinopril|sacubitril-valsartan.description: Concurrent ACE inhibitor and sacubitril-valsartan carries a serious risk of angio-oedema.
lisinopril|sacubitril-valsartan.recommendation: Never co-prescribe. Allow a 36-hour washout after stopping the ACE inhibitor.
